utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard any fresh updates yet, but I’m happy to check around while I’m out. If I hear anything about the repair drive, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Ira. Please do let me know if you hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — I’ll ask around while I’m out and let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just help spread the word and bring any tools you can spare.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — I’ll spread the word and see what tools I can bring.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, I think so, but I’d want to double-check the timing and who’s bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — I’ll double-check too, just to be sure.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive! I’m happy to help, I just need the details again.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Oren — we’re collecting tools, tape, screws, and any spare paint you can spare. If you have anything handy, just bring it by the community shed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it — I’ll bring whatever I can find by the community shed. If I forget, just wave me down and remind me again!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m in—what exactly needs repairing, and what’s the plan for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—mostly the broken stuff folks have been meaning to fix up, like that loose fence panel and the squeaky gate. I’ll check around and put the list together for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sounds good—send me the list once you’ve checked, and I’ll help keep track of the details.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Jules, sorry I’m late — how’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries, Dane — it’s going pretty well so far. We’ve got a few donations in, and I’m just helping keep everything moving.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Nice, glad it’s moving along. Want me to jump in and help with anything?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive, Gus—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I could use your drill and a couple clamps, if you’ve got them handy. I’ll bring them back as soon as I’m done.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Gus — I’ve got them and you’re welcome to borrow them. Just let me know when you’re ready and I’ll set them out for you.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t heard any updates yet on the repair drive, but I can keep an eye out and let you know if I spot where it’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Opal — I’d appreciate that. If you hear anything, please let me know so I can plan around the school run.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Of course — I’ll keep checking and tell you as soon as I find the location.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s coming together nicely — folks are pitching in with tools and supplies already. If you want, I can keep an ear out for the latest updates.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’d be great, Tess — thanks! I’ll start spreading the word, and if you hear anything new, let me know right away.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You got it — I’ll let you know the minute I hear anything. And if you spot anyone who still needs a hand, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what’s the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m thinking we start with the biggest fixes first, then see what people can handle. If you want, I can help make a simple list for it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yeah, let’s do that. What are the biggest fixes we should put at the top?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m planning to stop by the repair drive later and I’ll mention it to a few neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, thanks for letting me know — I’ll keep an ear out for updates.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll swing by later and let a few more neighbors know too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli — I’m lining up the repair drive now, and I’d love your help keeping things organized. If you’re free, we can sort out the first few homes together.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with that. Let’s sort out the first few homes together.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ll make a quick list of the first homes, and we can start with the ones most likely to need help. Thanks, Uli.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive is getting a good turnout this time. If you’ve got anything to drop off, I can let you know the best time to swing by.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s good to hear. Let me know the best time, and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll check the latest schedule and tell you the quietest window to come by. If you want, I can also keep an eye out for any items they’re especially short on.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, sorry I’m late — what do you need fixed for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — I’m just collecting the list for the repair drive, so I’ll repeat it to everyone once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’m ready to help. Just tell me the list when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out with the repair drive. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’s kind of you, Rey. I’m still sorting the list and could use help checking what’s already covered and what’s left.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that. Send me the list, and I’ll check what’s covered and what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need me to bring for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Just bring the repair items you can spare, especially tools, batteries, and any small parts. If you have a box or bag, that’d help keep everything organized.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll bring some tools, batteries, and a few small parts if I can find them. I can also bring a box to keep it organized.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Hana, I’m glad we’re doing the repair drive — it’s a great way to help out and bring folks together. Let me know what you need from me.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — I’ll check the details first so we can do this right. If you can send me the list of needed items and the drop-off time, I’ll take it from there.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll gather the item list and drop-off time and send it over soon. Thanks for taking the lead on this!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. What’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m still gathering the list of broken items and volunteers, and I’ll share the update as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — just let me know when you’ve got the list. I can help if you need another pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest on the repair drive yet—what’s the update, Gus?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: We’ve got a pretty good start—folks have been dropping off supplies, and I’m lining up tools and a couple extra hands for the weekend. If you need anything specific, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s great to hear, Gus—sounds like it’s coming together. I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam — could you help sort the donated items and stack them by size?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can sort the donated items and stack them by size.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a little worried about the logistics—who’s coordinating the repairs, and when do you need everything dropped off?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can coordinate the drop-offs and keep track of the repairs. If you can have everything here by Saturday morning, I’ll sort it out from there.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps, thanks. I’ll make sure everything’s here by Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I heard about the repair drive—count me in, and I’ll spread the word to a few neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’s wonderful, Quinn—thank you. I’ll keep track of the supplies and let you know what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect—send me the list when you have it, and I’ll start inviting folks who can help.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate that around school pickup and drop-off. What time are you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, thanks, Faye—maybe Saturday morning around 10? That should give folks time to swing by before lunch.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning at 10 works for me — I can help spread the word and keep it clear of school stuff.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Nell — I’m getting the repair drive organized and keeping track of the list. Let me know what needs attention first, and I’ll add it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — I’ve only heard bits and pieces, but I can check around and pass along anything I find. If there’s a top priority, let me know and I’ll keep an eye out.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’d be great, Nell — start with anything that affects safety or leaves someone without heat, water, or power. If you hear of those, send them my way and I’ll put them at the top of the list.
